stem.text: The gas in an engine does work on a piston of cross-sectional area $80\,\text{cm}^{2}$. The pressure on the piston has a constant value of $4.6 \times 10^{5}\,\text{Pa}$.

stem.alt: Cylinder containing a piston shown in its final position (dashed outline) and initial position, with a 25 cm arrow and an arrow labelled force of gas pushing piston.

stem.text: How much work is done by the gas on the piston when it moves through a distance of $25\,\text{cm}$?
